sections.label: Upload Settings
sections.help: Which systems "Upload to jet" types into the cockpit. All false in a new preset. A flagged system must be non-null (MFD/HARM/HTS are dereferenced without null checks).
sections.nullNote: F16Page.GetPages replaces a null system with new(); null is safe in a preset file and means "not included" in a Load/Save export.

sections.label: Capture Settings
sections.help: Where DTC puts points captured from the F10 map. App-side only, never uploaded.
sections.nullNote: F16Page.GetPages replaces a null system with new(); null is safe in a preset file and means "not included" in a Load/Save export.

sections.label: Steerpoints
sections.help: Route steerpoints with TOS, offset aimpoints, VIP and VRP. Filled from the planned route.
sections.nullNote: F16Page.GetPages replaces a null system with new(); null is safe in a preset file and means "not included" in a Load/Save export.

sections.label: CMS
sections.nullNote: F16Page.GetPages replaces a null system with new(); null is safe in a preset file and means "not included" in a Load/Save export.

sections.label: Radios
sections.help: COM1 (UHF, Radio1) and COM2 (VHF/FM, Radio2): 20 presets each plus the active channel.
sections.nullNote: F16Page.GetPages replaces a null system with new(); null is safe in a preset file and means "not included" in a Load/Save export.

sections.label: MFDs
sections.help: MFD formats per master mode (NAV, AA, AG, DGFT, MSL) and FCR settings.
sections.nullNote: F16Page.GetPages replaces a null system with new(); null is safe in a preset file and means "not included" in a Load/Save export.

sections.label: HARM
sections.help: HARM ALIC threat tables 1-3 (5 emitters each).
sections.nullNote: F16Page.GetPages replaces a null system with new(); null is safe in a preset file and means "not included" in a Load/Save export.

sections.label: HTS
sections.help: HTS manual threat table and enabled threat classes.
sections.nullNote: F16Page.GetPages replaces a null system with new(); null is safe in a preset file and means "not included" in a Load/Save export.

sections.label: Datalink
sections.help: Link 16 own callsign, flight lead, team STNs, TDOA and XMIT mode. All members nullable; null = not set.
sections.nullNote: F16Page.GetPages replaces a null system with new(); null is safe in a preset file and means "not included" in a Load/Save export.

sections.label: Misc
sections.help: Bingo, bullseye steerpoint, CARA ALOW, MSL floor, laser codes, TACAN, ILS. Each group has its own *ToBeUpdated flag.
sections.nullNote: F16Page.GetPages replaces a null system with new(); null is safe in a preset file and means "not included" in a Load/Save export.

fields.label: Aircraft code
fields.help: Always "F16C". ConfigLoader picks the C# type from this value; Load/Save import is ignored if it differs.

fields.label: Preset format version
fields.help: Always 2. Missing/1 together with a missing Upload sends the file through the V1 converter.

fields.label: Kneeboard notes
fields.help: Free text sent to the in-game DTC kneeboard when Upload.Kneeboard is true. Not a system: never copied by Load/Save "Load from file", only by whole-preset files.

fields.label: Upload Steerpoints
fields.help: Steerpoints incl. TOS, OA1/OA2, VIP and VRP.

fields.label: Upload CMS
fields.help: Chaff/flare bingo and every CMS program with ToBeUpdated=true.

fields.label: Upload Radios
fields.help: COM1/COM2 presets, COM1 guard and the active preset/manual frequency.

fields.label: Upload MFDs
fields.help: MFD formats (and FCR mode/az/bars/range) for each master mode with ToBeUpdated=true.

fields.label: Upload HARM / HTS
fields.help: HARM tables with ToBeUpdated=true, then the HTS manual table and HAD threat classes (always, ignoring the HTS *ToBeUpdated flags). Needs HARM/HTS carried on the jet.

fields.label: Upload Datalink
fields.help: Own callsign, flight lead, ownship index, member STNs, TDOA flags and XMIT mode.

fields.label: Upload Misc
fields.help: Bingo, bullseye, CARA ALOW, MSL floor, laser codes, TACAN, ILS: each only when its own *ToBeUpdated flag is true.

fields.label: Upload Kneeboard
fields.help: Send the preset summary and KneeboardNotes to the DTC in-game kneeboard after uploading.

fields.label: Navigation points

options.label: Add to end of the list
Add to end of the first gap
Add to specific range, starting from

fields.help: Where DTC places steerpoints captured from the F10 map (SteerpointCaptureMode). App-side only, never uploaded. Exporter: leave 0, or 2 with NavPointsRangeFrom set past the last route sequence so captures do not overwrite the planned route.

fields.label: Target points

options.label: Add to end of the list
Add to specific range, starting from

fields.allowedValuesNote: UI offers only 0 and 2 for target points
fields.help: Placement of captured target points (F10 "Add TGT"). 0 = end of list, 2 = range starting at TgtPointsRangeFrom. App-side only.

fields.label: Nav range start
fields.help: First steerpoint number used when NavPointsMode = 2.

fields.label: Target range start
fields.help: First steerpoint number used when TgtPointsMode = 2.

fields.label: Steerpoints
fields.help: Filled from the planned route. See Waypoints.Waypoints.

fields.label: Steerpoint list
fields.help: One entry per route point, in fly order, sorted by Sequence. Map route point i (1-based) to Sequence i. Keep the route within steerpoints 1-24: 25 is the default bullseye steerpoint (Misc.BullseyeWP) and 26+ are markpoints/HSD lines/alt-list in the jet; DTC itself allows 1-699 and uploads in list order via the DED STPT page. Must never be null (AfterLoadFromJson iterates it). The six Offset objects stay null while their Use* flag is false (the editor nulls them on save).

fields.label: Steerpoint #
fields.help: Route index (1-based). Unique. Recommended 1-24 (see list help).

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Route point name. Required (non-empty) by the editor; default "STPT n". Not uploaded to the jet (kneeboard/list only), so no length limit applies, but keep it short (<= 12 chars) for the kneeboard.

fields.label: Latitude
fields.help: DDM thousandths, e.g. "N 42°10.630’" (2-digit degrees, U+00B0, U+2019). The uploader types the digits; any other format throws.

fields.label: Longitude
fields.help: DDM thousandths, e.g. "E 042°28.840’" (3-digit zero-padded degrees).

fields.label: Elevation
fields.help: Feet MSL (route altitude or ground elevation for targets). Uploaded.

fields.label: TOS
fields.help: Route time-over-steerpoint HH:MM:SS, or null. Uploaded when not null. Never write "" (the uploader indexes the string).

fields.label: Target
fields.help: Set true for route points flagged as targets. Display/kneeboard only on the F-16 (not uploaded).

fields.label: Use offset aimpoints
fields.help: Upload OA1/OA2 for this steerpoint. OffsetAimpoint1 and 2 must then be non-null. Not derived from the route; default false.

fields.label: OA1
fields.help: Offset {Range, Bearing, Elevation} (decimals). Null unless UseOA is true; the editor creates new Offset() (all 0) when UseOA is ticked and nulls it when unticked.

fields.label: OA1 range
fields.help: Range in feet (integer part typed).

fields.label: OA1 bearing
fields.help: True bearing, 1 decimal.

fields.label: OA1 elevation
fields.help: Elevation feet MSL.

fields.label: OA2
fields.help: Offset {Range, Bearing, Elevation} (decimals). Null unless UseOA is true; the editor creates new Offset() (all 0) when UseOA is ticked and nulls it when unticked.

fields.label: OA2 range
fields.help: Range in feet (integer part typed).

fields.label: OA2 bearing
fields.help: True bearing, 1 decimal.

fields.label: OA2 elevation
fields.help: Elevation feet MSL.

fields.label: Is VIP
fields.help: This steerpoint is the visual initial point (only one; the uploader uses the last flagged). Mutually exclusive with UseVRP in the UI. VIPtoTGT and VIPtoPUP must then be non-null. Not derived from the route; default false.

fields.label: VIP to TGT
fields.help: Offset {Range, Bearing, Elevation} (decimals). Null unless UseVIP is true; the editor creates new Offset() (all 0) when UseVIP is ticked and nulls it when unticked.

fields.label: VIP to TGT range
fields.help: Range in NM, 1 decimal.

fields.label: VIP to TGT bearing
fields.help: True bearing, 1 decimal.

fields.label: VIP to TGT elevation
fields.help: Target elevation feet MSL.

fields.label: VIP to PUP
fields.help: Offset {Range, Bearing, Elevation} (decimals). Null unless UseVIP is true; the editor creates new Offset() (all 0) when UseVIP is ticked and nulls it when unticked.

fields.label: VIP to PUP range
fields.help: Range in NM, 1 decimal.

fields.label: VIP to PUP bearing
fields.help: True bearing, 1 decimal.

fields.label: VIP to PUP elevation
fields.help: Pull-up point elevation feet MSL.

fields.label: Is VRP target
fields.help: This steerpoint is the target for a visual reference point (only one). TGTtoVRP and TGTtoPUP must then be non-null. Not derived from the route; default false.

fields.label: TGT to VRP
fields.help: Offset {Range, Bearing, Elevation} (decimals). Null unless UseVRP is true; the editor creates new Offset() (all 0) when UseVRP is ticked and nulls it when unticked.

fields.label: TGT to VRP range
fields.help: Range in feet (integer).

fields.label: TGT to VRP bearing
fields.help: True bearing, 1 decimal.

fields.label: TGT to VRP elevation
fields.help: Elevation feet MSL.

fields.label: TGT to PUP
fields.help: Offset {Range, Bearing, Elevation} (decimals). Null unless UseVRP is true; the editor creates new Offset() (all 0) when UseVRP is ticked and nulls it when unticked.

fields.label: TGT to PUP range
fields.help: Range in feet (integer).

fields.label: TGT to PUP bearing
fields.help: True bearing, 1 decimal.

fields.label: TGT to PUP elevation
fields.help: Elevation feet MSL.

fields.label: CMS programs
fields.help: Exactly 6 programs (MAN 1-6). A 5-element array gets program 6 appended on load; null throws in AfterLoadFromJson. All ten members of each program must be present (constructor-bound).

fields.label: Program
fields.help: Program number 1-6, equals array index + 1.

fields.label: Chaff burst qty
fields.help: Chaff cartridges per burst (BQ).

fields.label: Chaff burst interval
fields.help: Chaff burst interval (BI), seconds, 3 decimals (mask 00.000).

fields.label: Chaff salvo qty
fields.help: Chaff number of salvos (SQ).

fields.label: Chaff salvo interval
fields.help: Chaff salvo interval (SI), seconds, 2 decimals (mask 000.00).

fields.label: Flare burst qty
fields.help: Flare cartridges per burst (BQ).

fields.label: Flare burst interval
fields.help: Flare burst interval (BI), seconds, 3 decimals (mask 00.000).

fields.label: Flare salvo qty
fields.help: Flare number of salvos (SQ).

fields.label: Flare salvo interval
fields.help: Flare salvo interval (SI), seconds, 2 decimals (mask 000.00).

fields.label: Upload this program
fields.help: Only programs with true are typed in (others are skipped).

fields.label: Chaff bingo
fields.help: Always uploaded when Upload.CMS is true.

fields.label: Flare bingo
fields.help: Always uploaded when Upload.CMS is true.

fields.label: COM1 (UHF) presets
fields.help: Preset channels 1-20 (null or [] = none). Only filled channels are present; Number identifies the channel. UHF 225.000-399.975 MHz.

fields.label: Channel
fields.help: Preset channel number; unique within the radio. Always include it (constructor-bound).

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Label for the channel (kneeboard only, not uploaded).

fields.label: Frequency
fields.help: UHF 225.000-399.975 MHz; "ddd.ddd" with a dot (the uploader splits on "."); last digit 0/2/5/7. 2-decimal values get a 0 appended on load.

fields.label: Manual frequency
fields.help: Frequency set when Mode = 1 (Frequency). UHF 225.000-399.975 MHz.

fields.label: Active preset
fields.help: Preset channel selected when Mode = 2, as a STRING "1".."20".

fields.label: Guard
fields.help: Enable UHF guard receiver (COM1 only).

fields.label: Mode
fields.help: RadioMode: 1 = tune SelectedFrequency, 2 = select SelectedPreset, 0 = leave the active channel alone. A radio with everything default is skipped.

fields.label: COM2 (VHF/FM) presets
fields.help: Preset channels 1-20 (null or [] = none). Only filled channels are present; Number identifies the channel. VHF 108.000-151.975 MHz or FM 30.00-87.97 MHz.

fields.label: Channel
fields.help: Preset channel number; unique within the radio. Always include it (constructor-bound).

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Label for the channel (kneeboard only, not uploaded).

fields.label: Frequency
fields.help: VHF 108.000-151.975 MHz or FM 30.00-87.97 MHz; "ddd.ddd" with a dot (the uploader splits on "."); last digit 0/2/5/7. 2-decimal values get a 0 appended on load.

fields.label: Manual frequency
fields.help: Frequency set when Mode = 1 (Frequency). VHF 108.000-151.975 MHz or FM 30.00-87.97 MHz.

fields.label: Active preset
fields.help: Preset channel selected when Mode = 2, as a STRING "1".."20".

fields.label: Guard
fields.help: Not offered for COM2 in the UI; leave false.

fields.label: Mode
fields.help: RadioMode: 1 = tune SelectedFrequency, 2 = select SelectedPreset, 0 = leave the active channel alone. A radio with everything default is skipped.

fields.label: MFD formats per master mode
fields.help: Exactly 5 entries in order NAV, AA, AG, DGFT, MSL. Null throws in AfterLoadFromJson.

fields.label: Master mode
fields.help: Fixed by array position.

fields.label: Upload this mode
fields.help: Only modes with true are uploaded (non-NAV first, NAV last).

fields.label: Left MFD
fields.help: MFDConfiguration (constructor-bound; keep all members).

fields.label: Left MFD selected page
fields.help: Which of Page1-3 is shown; must point at a non-BLANK page.

fields.label: Left MFD page 1
fields.help: MFD format on OSB 12/13/14. A page may not repeat on one MFD (except BLANK).

fields.label: Left MFD page 2
fields.help: MFD format on OSB 12/13/14. A page may not repeat on one MFD (except BLANK).

fields.label: Left MFD page 3
fields.help: MFD format on OSB 12/13/14. A page may not repeat on one MFD (except BLANK).

fields.label: Left MFD FCR mode
fields.help: Only used when one of the pages is FCR. AA/NAV/MSL/DGFT: RWS/VSR/TWS; AG/NAV/DGFT: GM/GMT/SEA. On load an FCR page with nulls gets RWS/6/4/40 (NAV/AA/MSL) or GM/40/6 (AG).

fields.label: Left MFD FCR azimuth
fields.help: FCR azimuth scan.

fields.label: Left MFD FCR bars
fields.help: Air-to-air modes only (UI shows az/bars as "6/4" etc.).

fields.label: Right MFD
fields.help: MFDConfiguration (constructor-bound; keep all members).

fields.label: Right MFD selected page
fields.help: Which of Page1-3 is shown; must point at a non-BLANK page.

fields.label: Right MFD page 1
fields.help: MFD format on OSB 12/13/14. A page may not repeat on one MFD (except BLANK).

fields.label: Right MFD page 2
fields.help: MFD format on OSB 12/13/14. A page may not repeat on one MFD (except BLANK).

fields.label: Right MFD page 3
fields.help: MFD format on OSB 12/13/14. A page may not repeat on one MFD (except BLANK).

fields.label: Right MFD FCR mode
fields.help: Only used when one of the pages is FCR. AA/NAV/MSL/DGFT: RWS/VSR/TWS; AG/NAV/DGFT: GM/GMT/SEA. On load an FCR page with nulls gets RWS/6/4/40 (NAV/AA/MSL) or GM/40/6 (AG).

fields.label: Right MFD FCR azimuth
fields.help: FCR azimuth scan.

fields.label: Right MFD FCR bars
fields.help: Air-to-air modes only (UI shows az/bars as "6/4" etc.).

fields.label: HARM ALIC tables
fields.help: Exactly 3 tables.

fields.label: Table
fields.help: Table number 1-3 (public field).

fields.label: Upload this table
fields.help: Only tables with true are uploaded (with Upload.HARMHTS).

fields.label: Emitters
fields.help: 5 emitter slots.

fields.label: Emitter HARM code
fields.help: HARMCode from dtc-emitters.json; 0 = empty slot.

fields.label: HTS manual table
fields.help: Up to 8 HARM codes for the HAD MAN table (default []). Must not be null.

fields.label: Emitter HARM code
fields.help: HARMCode from dtc-emitters.json; 0 = empty.

fields.label: Manual table to be updated
fields.help: Stored only: the uploader ignores it and always writes the manual table when Upload.HARMHTS.

fields.label: HTS threat classes
fields.help: Classes 1-11 (index 0 = class 1), default all true.

fields.label: Class enabled
fields.help: HAD threat class N enabled (UI label "Class N").

fields.label: Manual table enable to be updated
fields.help: Stored only: ignored by the uploader.

fields.label: Manual table (MAN) enabled
fields.help: Select MAN on the HAD threat class page (public field).

fields.label: Set own callsign
fields.help: bool? checkbox; null = never touched (shown unchecked).

fields.label: Own callsign
fields.help: Exactly 4 chars: two letters + two digits, e.g. "VP11".

fields.label: Flight lead
fields.help: bool? checkbox; null = never touched (shown unchecked).

fields.label: Set team members
fields.help: bool? checkbox (null = never touched); enables uploading Members/OwnshipIndex/TDOA.

fields.label: Ownship index
fields.help: Own position 1-8 in the team list (radio buttons); null = not set.

fields.label: Team member STNs
fields.help: null, or exactly 8 entries (the uploader indexes 0-7). The app creates new string[8] on first edit.

fields.label: Member STN
fields.help: 5-digit STN as text, e.g. "00201"; "-1", "" or null = empty slot.

fields.label: TDOA members
fields.help: null, or exactly 8 booleans.

fields.label: TDOA
fields.help: Member N is a TDOA member.

fields.label: XMIT mode
fields.help: DatalinkMode? enum.

fields.label: Upload bingo
fields.help: Upload the matching value(s) when Upload.Misc is true.

fields.label: Upload bullseye
fields.help: Upload the matching value(s) when Upload.Misc is true.

fields.label: Bullseye steerpoint
fields.help: Steerpoint number used as bullseye (default 25). The F-16 has no bullseye coordinate field in DTC; to set a position, put it in this steerpoint.

fields.label: CARA ALOW
fields.help: UI rounds to the nearest 10 ft.

fields.label: Upload CARA ALOW
fields.help: Upload the matching value(s) when Upload.Misc is true.

fields.label: Upload MSL floor
fields.help: Upload the matching value(s) when Upload.Misc is true.

fields.label: Upload laser settings
fields.help: Upload the matching value(s) when Upload.Misc is true.

fields.label: TGP laser code
fields.help: 4 digits: first 1-2, others 1-8.

fields.label: LST code
fields.help: 4 digits: first 1-2, others 1-8.

fields.label: Laser start time
fields.help: Seconds before impact.

fields.label: Upload TACAN
fields.help: Upload the matching value(s) when Upload.Misc is true.

fields.label: ILS frequency
fields.help: Decimal, ILS channels 108.10-111.95 (odd tenths).

fields.label: Upload ILS
fields.help: Upload the matching value(s) when Upload.Misc is true.
